user.title: Configure Qwen3-TTS
user.description:
Choose where the model runs.

Enter the address of a Qwen3-TTS server in your network, or leave the field empty to run the model inside Home Assistant.

data_description.server_url: Address of the server started with `server/qwen3_tts_server.py`, for example `http://192.168.1.139:8000`. Leave empty to run the model inside Home Assistant (Home Assistant OS and Container cannot install PyTorch).

server.title: Qwen3-TTS server
server.description: The model runs on the server: Home Assistant only sends the text and receives the audio. Make sure the server is running before continuing.

data_description.ref_audio: Path to the audio file whose voice will be cloned (WAV or MP3). Keep the default to use the voice shipped with the integration.
data_description.ref_text: Exact transcript of the reference audio. When filled in, voice cloning is noticeably more accurate.
data_description.language: Default language used for speech synthesis.

local.title: Configure Qwen3-TTS
local.description: Set up the local Qwen3-TTS model. The model must already be downloaded into Home Assistant, for example in `/config/models`.

data_description.model_path: Folder containing the Qwen3-TTS model downloaded from Hugging Face.
data_description.ref_audio: Path to the audio file whose voice will be cloned (WAV or MP3). Keep the default to use the voice shipped with the integration.
data_description.ref_text: Exact transcript of the reference audio. When filled in, voice cloning is noticeably more accurate.
data_description.language: Default language used for speech synthesis.

error.model_path_not_found: The model folder does not exist.
error.model_incomplete: The model folder is incomplete. Download the whole repository from Hugging Face, including the speech_tokenizer folder and generation_config.json.
error.ref_audio_not_found: The reference audio file does not exist.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to contact the server at this address. Check the URL, the port and that the server is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid address starting with http:// or https://, without spaces.
error.server_error: The server answered but cannot load the model. Check the server log.
